market_outlook.short_term: Oil >$100 remains the dominant macro variable, pressuring bonds and capping tech rallies. Dow's third losing week signals rotation. S&P 500 enters historically favorable Q4 window but oil/inflation risk caps upside. Expect volatility around Trump-Xi meeting and Paramount-Warner resolution. Cybersecurity outperforms chips. Regional banks under pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle continues but financing risk (junk bonds, hidden liabilities) warrants caution. Energy transition accelerates (Saudi Ceer EV, Dangote Africa plan). US-China thaw supports global growth. Diesel shortage to 2027 keeps energy premium. India and Asia benefit from trade rerouting. S&P 500 Q4 seasonality (34/41 up) supports medium-term upside if oil stabilizes.
